tess_csm: Weekly mode snapshot for Peregrine — p95/p99 by route+model, streaming vs non-streaming. Quick table and next steps.

tess_csm: Summary (top routes):
- /chat (short): stream p95 230ms / p99 980ms; non-stream p95 490ms / p99 2.9s.
- /batch (long): stream p95 1.7s / p99 3.0s; non-stream p95 1.5s / p99 3.2s.
- Models: rw-med-7b-Q shows biggest non-stream p99 gap on /chat (2.9s vs 1.0s).

sam_eng: Paste of trimmed CSV for triage:
```
route,model,stream_p95,stream_p99,non_p95,non_p99
/chat,rw-med-7b-Q,230ms,1.0s,490ms,2.9s
/chat,llama-2-7b,200ms,850ms,210ms,1.1s
/batch,rw-med-7b-Q,1.7s,3.0s,1.5s,3.2s
```

nina_sre: No pod restarts. Observed low KV hit (~11%) and short-window retry storms causing queue spikes on non-stream. Suggest: enable prefix KV cache for /chat and raise per-worker batch from 6->10 on Peregrine dedicated pool. Expect non-stream p99 improvement ~30%.

sam_eng: I'll add a feature-flagged canary for prefix cache on 2 workers and run the metric query every 30m. SQL: SELECT percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) as p99 FROM request_logs WHERE account='peregrine' AND route='/chat' AND model='rw-med-7b-Q' AND ts > now()-interval '1 hour';

leo_pm: For renewal notes, include estimated cost impact: "If retries reduced, expected ~7-10% weekly cost drop."

tess_csm: Action items: eng (sam) canary 12h, SRE (nina) bump batch + monitor (post-canary), CS (tess) customer note w/ ETA 24h. I'll update renewal tracker. Next sync Thu 09:30 PT. :calendar:
